catalysts.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue $5.1B (+36% y/y, beat ~$4.56B consensus); non-GAAP diluted EPS $20.07 vs ~$16.19 consensus (+70% y/y). Sanofi-reported Dupixent sales +35% y/y to $6.5B; EYLEA HD US sales +62% y/y to $699M, FY2026 EYLEA HD sales guided to grow >50% y/y. Expanded Sanofi collaboration adds a $1.0B upfront payment plus up to $7.0B in milestones. Shares hit a new 52-week high on the print; since given back some of that move (-4.4% today) on no fresh company-specific news found.

REGN.what: Biopharmaceutical: Eylea/Eylea HD (wet AMD, diabetic eye disease), Dupixent (atopic dermatitis, asthma; profit-shared with Sanofi), plus Libtayo, Praluent and a broadening oncology/rare-disease pipeline.
